Interface VecDelta

All Known Implementing Classes:
VecDelta.Linear, VecDelta.Stepped
public sealed interface VecDelta permits VecDelta.Linear, VecDelta.Stepped
A relative movement encoded against the receiver's last known position, either a single delta or a series of timed deltas. Each component is a signed 1/4096 block offset, so a single delta cannot span more than 8 blocks on an axis.

The step count is not part of the payload, it travels in the packed properties of the packet carrying the delta, which is why reading takes it as an argument.
